name: cavemio-logo-marquee
title: Logo marquee
description: A quiet strip of logos that notices you: it eases to a stop on hover and the logo you point at stays bright.

cavemio.usage: import { LogoMarquee } from "@/components/logo-marquee"; , …]} />
cavemio.accessibility:
- Screen readers get one list of logos; the copy that makes the loop seamless is hidden.
- Runs on the Web Animations API with a single transform, so it costs nothing per frame; the stop is a tween of playbackRate, not a jump.
- With reduced motion the logos sit still in a centred, wrapping row.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: logos
props.description: – · Images or inline SVGs, each with an accessible name.

props.name: speed
props.description: 36 · Pixels per second, whatever the strip’s length.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: true · Ease to a stop while pointed at.

features.title: A seamless loop
features.description: The speed is set in pixels per second, so a longer strip never moves faster.

features.title: Soft edges
features.description: The strip fades out over the outer 12% on each side.

features.title: It eases to a stop
features.description: Point at it and it slows to a halt instead of freezing. The logo under the pointer stays bright and the rest dim.

features.title: Either direction
features.description: Choose left or right, and the space between logos.

features.title: Cheap to run
features.description: One transform on the Web Animations API, so it costs nothing per frame.

features.title: Accessible
features.description: Screen readers get one list of logos. With reduced motion the logos sit still in a centred, wrapping row.

states.title: moving
states.description: Two copies of the set loop seamlessly at speed px/s, masked to fade over the outer 12% on each side.

states.title: hover
states.description: The playback rate eases from 1 to 0 over 650ms; the hovered logo goes to full ink, the others to 35%.

states.title: leave
states.description: The rate eases back to 1 from wherever it was.
